title: Tech Note: Building a 4D Application
author: Tai Bui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: The overall Application Builder workflow, compiled-structure vs stand-alone vs client/server build types, and the buildApp settings file mechanism remain 4D's current build/deployment model; the note is also notable for capturing the exact v19-era transition point where buildApp.xml was renamed buildApp.4DSettings and Project mode's PackProject setting first appeared.
related_updates: Project mode (.4DZ compiled structure, PackProject setting) has since become the default and near-universal database format, making the binary-mode .4DC path increasingly a legacy option
The Application Builder UI and Build Application command remain largely the same shape in current 4D versions, though specific dialogs/options have been refined release over release
